description:
Dispatch a task or code review contract to another local AI agent host via the shared SQLite WAL mesh.

### Purpose
Registers a new contract in SUBMITTED status with full-file SHA-256 fingerprint snapshots of all target files, establishing an immutable baseline for cross-host verification.

### Usage Guidelines
- When to use: Use when requesting code reviews, architecture audits, implementation, or test generation from a target agent (e.g., target_agent="workbuddy" or "antigravity").
- When NOT to use:
  - Do NOT use to claim or execute tasks (use poll_next_task).
  - Do NOT use to check task status or inspect outputs (use inspect_mesh_state).
  - Do NOT use if the target host does not share the same local filesystem access to workspace_root.
- Prerequisites: workspace_root must be a valid directory accessible by both hosts. Pointer files must exist on disk and be saved. Sensitive files (.env, keys, credentials, .git/config) and path escapes are strictly blocked.

### Behavior & Side Effects
- Mutates database: Synchronously inserts a single row into contracts with status='SUBMITTED' in SQLite WAL (~/.ferrycat/mesh.db).
- SHA-256 Snapshot: Computes 64-char hex SHA-256, byte size, and first/last lines for each pointer. Emits a warning if any file was modified within the last 3 seconds (indicating unsaved IDE buffers).
- Lifecycle & Expiry: Starts the queue_ttl_sec countdown (default: 1800s / 30m). If the target agent never claims it before queue_ttl_sec elapses, the contract lazily transitions to TIMED_OUT.
- Once claimed, execution is governed by exec_ttl_sec (tiered default: 1800s for review/audit, 300s for implementation/test).

### Return Value
Returns { contract_id: string, status: 'SUBMITTED', created_at: number, files: Array<{ path, size, mtime_ms, sha256, first_line, last_line, line_range? }>, warning?: string }. Note: requester_agent / target_agent / task_type / title / TTLs are NOT echoed back — read them via inspect_mesh_state if needed.

context_summary.description: Detailed task instructions, audit focus areas, architectural constraints, and background context for the worker agent (1-20000 chars).

contract_schema.description: Optional Draft-07 JSON Schema that structured_output must validate against. Bounded to 1MB and max 32 depth (FC-302).

exec_ttl_sec.description: Execution TTL in seconds once CLAIMED (default: 1800s for review/audit, 300s for implementation/test). Worker must fulfill, extend, release, or fail within this window.

pointers.description: Array of 1 to 50 target file pointers hashed with full-file SHA-256 and snapshot boundaries for tamper detection.

line_range.description: Optional [startLine, endLine] 1-based inclusive line range focus for the task.

path.description: File path relative to workspace_root. Must exist on disk. Sensitive files (.env*, *.pem, *.key, id_rsa*, *credentials*, *secret*, .npmrc, .git/config) and path escapes are strictly rejected.

queue_ttl_sec.description: Queue expiration TTL in seconds while status is SUBMITTED (default: 1800s / 30m). Transitions to TIMED_OUT if unclaimed before expiry.

requester_agent.description: Requester agent identifier. Defaults to AGENT_NAME env var (e.g., "antigravity", "workbuddy").

target_agent.description: Target worker agent identifier expected to claim and execute this contract (e.g., "workbuddy", "antigravity").

task_type.description: Type of contract task. Tiered default execution TTL: 1800s for code_review/architecture_audit, 300s for implementation/test_generation.

title.description: Concise contract title (1-120 chars) summarizing the goal of the request.

workspace_root.description: Absolute canonical path to the shared local workspace directory accessible by both hosts (e.g. "F:/git/FerryCat"). Path escapes and sensitive files are blocked.

name: dispatch_contract
